description: The places themselves (2.58 m: shops, gyms, cafes, parks, pubs, GPs, ... in 234 categories) near a typed id or {lat, lon} (radius_m 100-3000) or inside an area, by category (describe_data(kind: 'place') lists them) and brand (PureGym, Waitrose). Each: name, category, brand, metres, walk minutes (straight line, an estimate), its LSOA and sources. ODbL attribution; the full places.csv download link. Places of worship are never listed.

area.description: [scope] Places inside this area's shape: a typed area id.
area.title: Area

brand.description: [filter: exact] A brand, any case, e.g. PureGym, Waitrose.
brand.title: Brand

category.description: [filter: exact] A place category key from describe_data(kind: 'place'), exact case, e.g. fitness_centre (or gym), cafe, pub.
category.title: Category

near.description: [scope] Distance from this: a typed id (uk:lsoa:…, uk:msoa:…, uk:lad:…, pc:…, uprn:…, school:…, place:…) or {lat, lon} from search_places. One of near or area.
near.title: Near

page.description: [paging] Page; next gives the following one.
page.title: Page

name: get_places
title: Get places
